bioconda.name: annevo
bioconda.summary: Deep learning-based ab initio gene annotation from genome sequence.
bioconda.description:
ANNEVO is a deep learning-based ab initio gene annotation method for
understanding genome function. It models distal sequence information
and joint evolutionary relationships across diverse species directly
from genomes to predict gene structures without relying on extrinsic
evidence (e.g. RNA-seq, protein homology).
